findings.text: the age is rendered without reference to the row's own counts, so a row can carry 0b beside 7hb — my probe renders exactly that for a reading whose record count is 0 while the pane still holds the blocked member — because membership is the pane's observed _entered view while the count is the record's, and no test covers the disagreement.

the page states that the counter and the age 'always describe the same population', which the row above refutes; the sentence's true half (the state vocabulary is read from the partition at call time) does not carry the conclusion drawn from it, and a later reader checking against this claim would find no gap to look for.

index('w') resolves to the from_state word 'working' at column 66 on every row (my probe prints 66 for all three), so the assertion holds whether or not the counter block moved; the rindex('u') half at :195 is the half that measures the block.

the landing comment's data-when is 2026-09-18T18:30:00Z, which postdates its own commit bffa7d94 (16:36:11Z author date) and the review's reading instant, so the plan records a landing time that had not happened.

justifications.durability: Examined the nine committed cases and their shape — the central assertion cannot hold at base by construction, since I loaded base 6f492d0f's ticker source and confirmed _age_cells is absent there and the fixtures render identically, so a silent return to the old row turns the suite red; docked one because tests/test_counter_carries_age.py:194 asserts row.index('w'), which my probe shows resolves to the from_state word 'working' at column 66 on every row and therefore passes even if the counter columns moved (the rindex('u') half at :195 does measure the block), no case pins the count/age disagreement reproduced in probe_counter_age.py, and the day and 99d+ arms of _age_span (reckon/crew/ticker.py:459) have no case.
justifications.evidence: Examined the gate clause by clause against the done-when (negative half first at tests/test_counter_carries_age.py:84, same-count-different-age at :101, widths at :198, the clause-wins bargain at :214), re-ran the focused gate myself at the reviewed head (100 passed in 1.42s across the three ticker files, reviewer-ticker-gate.log), reproduced every before/after movement in probe_counter_age.py, read the recorded receipts (baseline-suite.log 1 failed 210 passed at the base revision, after-suite.log 1 failed 219 passed at the head), and re-ran the single failure myself at head (reviewer-recovery-test.log — the same refusal, the test's temporary repository is not a git worktree, identical at both revisions and reported under follow-ons rather than triaged); docked two for record accuracy: the evidence page's claim that the counter and the age 'always describe the same population' (docs/evidence/archive/an-orchestrator-is-bound-by-its-inbox-landed.html:66) is refuted by the row my probe renders, and the landing comment's data-when of 2026-09-18T18:30:00Z (docs/plans/an-orchestrator-is-bound-by-its-inbox.html:316) postdates its own commit bffa7d94 (16:36:11Z author date) and the review's reading instant; not examined: the six-file crew gate was taken as receipts rather than re-executed (a 15s run belongs off the login node), and I ran tests/test_crew_ticker_layout.py without reading its assertions.
justifications.fit: Examined both commit subjects and bodies (conventional, bodied, no attribution trailer, no plan identifier), the new symbols and comments against the repository naming rules (ACTIONABLE_CELLS, AGE, _epoch, _age_span, _bucket_of, Ticker._register, Ticker._oldest_age — none carries a plan, stage or ticket reference), the helpers against the module's own idiom (refusing to fabricate a reading matches the DIM_MARKER convention at ticker.py:76, and _bucket_of's call-time import is required rather than stylistic because reckon/crew/recovery.py:36 imports this module at import time), and ruff on the changed paths (1 finding, FURB162 in the pre-existing local_clock at ticker.py:421, the base carrying the same one at its :404 — none added); not examined: the pane's re-attach path that the code's own note names as the reading's limit.
justifications.goal_fidelity: Examined both reviewed commits (df99ec0a feat, bffa7d94 docs) against base 6f492d0f, the ticker diff, the plan section, and my own probe (probe_counter_age.py, log reviewer-base-head-probe.log): the base ticker has no age capability and renders the same-count fixtures identically, the head renders 2mb against 7hb, keeps the oldest member's 7h when a fresh arrival lands beside it, drops the reading to 2m when the oldest is cleared at an unchanged count, prints no age field (never 0m) for a bucket holding nobody, and holds its width exactly at 180 and 208 with a crowding clause winning the margin whole; the two work-in-progress cells carry none, with the state vocabulary read at call time from the fleet partition (reckon/crew/ticker.py:476) and only the two actionable buckets named here (ticker.py:261); not examined: the plan section's other half (a count of items unchanged since the reader last saw a row), which this node's done-when does not claim, and any live watch stream — I judged rendered fixtures only.
justifications.scope_discipline: Examined the diffstat against the four declared paths — reckon/crew/ticker.py 181 insertions and 1 replaced line, tests/test_counter_carries_age.py 230 new, docs/plans/an-orchestrator-is-bound-by-its-inbox.html 3 insertions only with no plan-version or plan-modified meta line touched, docs/evidence/archive/an-orchestrator-is-bound-by-its-inbox-landed.html 98 new — confirmed the vocabulary module reckon/crew/recovery.py is unmodified as the dispatch required, the reviewed worktree clean at bffa7d94, and both commits not yet reachable from main (my ancestor checks) with no push attempted and nothing in the diff outside the goal; re-confirmed the worktree clean at bffa7d94 at 2026-09-19T11:00Z (rev-parse and status --porcelain), so no surviving third-party change; not examined: a transient touch reverted before my second reading.
